BiblicalUsage: Mizraq is a bowl for sprinkling — one of the plain, working vessels of the tabernacle and the temple, made to carry blood and offerings to the altar. Princes bring silver bowls at the dedication, and Zechariah sees a day when even the bowls before the altar will be holy to the LORD.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even the bowls are consecrated: nothing that serves God in His house is common.
